{{Quote|In fact, when ‘Emperor’ Palpatine decided to arrest me for treason, one of his lapdog Senators informed Bail beforehand. Bail, while pretending to gloat with the swine, sent one of his men to warn me. I got off-planet about two minutes ahead of the ISB agents.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />}}
In approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Senior Senator of the Republic|Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] '''escaped''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to avoid being [[Prison/Legends|arrested]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Mothma had been openly critical of the Empire's reign and worked in secret to develop an organised resistance against the Empire, which was discovered by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau (ISB)]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] denounced Mothma as a traitor and ordered her arrest. Another [[Unidentified senator (Bail Organa)|senator]] informed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], unaware that he was Mothma's ally.

Organa sent an [[Unidentified male (Bail Organa)|informant]] to warn Mothma, and with the help of a [[Unidentified bodyguard|bodyguard]] she escaped Coruscant [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] ahead of ISB agents. She subsequently traveled across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to further the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cause, facing danger from both Imperial forces and suspicious rebels. News of Mothma's attempted arrest led to a [[Massacre on Chandrila|massacre]] on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Chandrila and caused other senators to realise the dangers posed by the Empire. Mothma was eventually briefly [[Corellian Treaty|captured]] by the Empire but [[Battle on Death Star I|escaped]]. She continued leading the Rebel Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and ultimately returned to Coruscant as [[Chief Councilor]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|To take up the sword of rebellion would be treason.''"<br>"''Perhaps, that is what the galaxy needs.|Bail Organa and Mon Mothma|<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" />}}
[[File:MonMothma-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|250px|Senator Mon Mothma's work to build the resistance against the Empire made her an enemy of the state.]]
[[Senior Senator of the Republic|Senior Senator]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] was mistrustful of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ever since his [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Her concerns escalated following Palpatine's [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> and the subsequent loss of the Senate's political influence.<ref name="Annual 2008">''[[Star Wars Annual 2008]]''</ref> Mothma's outspoken criticisms<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> were met with physical threats, and she became convinced that the Imperial system could not be restored from within.<ref name="Rebellion Era">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> In the [[Cantham House Meetings]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she began secretly discussing the topic of revolution to restore the Republic with [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

Organa was believed to be Mothma's opponent in the Senate and initially rejected the idea of rebellion, based on the belief that legal reforms could work, but was swayed following the perpetration of the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> and other atrocities by the Empire,<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" /> along with the persuasions of [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]] operative [[Bria Tharen]].<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> He began supporting Mothma's growing resistance movement with [[Currency/Legends|funds]], [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], and information while avoiding suspicion.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> Mothma also worked to establish independent rebel cells that were unaware of each other's existence.<ref name="ROTJ">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref>

Eventually, the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau (ISB)]] discovered Mothma's rebel activities,<ref name="Annual 1999">''[[Star Wars Annual 1999]]''</ref> and she was named an enemy of the state.<ref name="Thrawn trilogy">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Around this time, Palpatine launched a crackdown against dissidents, arresting and murdering many,<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> while the Senate relinquished further powers to Palpatine.<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook 2nd">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> In approximately [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> having lost patience with Mothma,<ref name="TFU campaign guide" /> Palpatine decided to have her arrested for [[Treason/Legends|treason]],<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> which carried a [[Death/Legends|death]] sentence.<ref name="Fact File 36">{{FactFile|36|MOT 1-4|Mon Mothma}}</ref> Rumors of the intended arrest spread,<ref name="Do No Harm">{{JournalCite|10|Do No Harm|reprint=1}}</ref> and a [[Unidentified senator (Bail Organa)|loyalist senator]] informed Organa that it was to occur, to which the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] pretended to gloat.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

==The escape==
{{Quote|Following Ghorman, Bail Organa secretly helped me to divert weapons and funds, and even more importantly, information, to the growing Resistance effort. However, I was eventually discovered, and fled the capital only moments before the ISB came to arrest me.|Mon Mothma, in a speech to the Agamarian Resistance|<ref name="Farlander">{{StoryCite|story=The Farlander Papers|book=Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}</ref>}}
Organa sent a [[Unidentified male (Bail Organa)|man]] to warn Mothma while agents of the ISB were sent to arrest her.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> A [[Unidentified bodyguard|bodyguard]] escorted Mothma to safety,<ref name="TFU campaign guide" /> and she escaped Coruscant<ref name="NEGTC" /> ahead of the arrival of the agents by roughly two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], according to her estimation.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />

==Aftermath==
===Consequences and reactions===
[[File:Alliance_Starbird.svg|thumb|left|250px|In hiding, Mon Mothma continued developing the Alliance to Restore the Republic (symbol pictured).]]
Mothma met with Tharen shortly after her escape, where she thanked the operative for her role in persuading Organa to take military action against the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> On the run,<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> but no longer beholden to the need for loyalty to the Empire, Mothma began to work openly toward building the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] using the frameworks she and Organa had discussed to help unite a variety of diverse groups.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> Going underground,<ref name="NEC" /> she traveled across [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> to various oppressed planets and spoke to rebel groups<ref name="NEC" /> to convince them to work together,<ref name="Age of Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> and also established new organizations. Her fame allowed Mothma to access important noble figures and leaders of industries,<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> but also served as a hindrance, as some rebels suspected that her public opposition to the Emperor was a ruse to allow their groups to be infiltrated. The former senator had many brushes with death from both Imperial forces and guerrilla agents,<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> and also faced danger from suspicious rebel groups.<ref name="Annual 2008" /> Mothma was convicted of treason in absentia ten times by the Empire, and was arguably the [[Imperial Most Wanted List|most wanted]] person in the galaxy for a time.<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook 2nd" />

Following Mothma's escape, Organa chose to remain within the Senate, hoping to use the rule of law to restore freedom,<ref name="Thrawn trilogy" /> although his movements were watched by Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. The escape made Bel Iblis realise that his own time was running short, and he later narrowly escaped an [[Bombing of the Treitamma Political Center|explosion]] designed to kill him that claimed the lives of his [[Bel Iblis family|family]]. Bel Iblis, Mothma, and Organa continued to meet secretly in discrete locations across the galaxy.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Mothma's disappearance from public life prompted [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]] senator [[Gebnerret Vibrion]] to go underground; he later led his own [[Gebnerret Vibrion's resistance group|resistance group]].<ref name="Do No Harm" /> Although Imperial-aligned news sources claimed that Mothma had resigned her position,<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets 3">{{JournalCite|3|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> the Emperor's efforts to arrest Mothma became public knowledge,<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> which led to public anti-Imperial demonstrations on her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] Chandrila and culminated in a [[Massacre on Chandrila|massacre]] there.<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> The Chandrilan senator was succeeded in the Senate by the Chandrilan [[Canna Omonda]], who appeared to some to have not learned from Mothma's fate, as she also criticized Palpatine publicly, which resulted in her execution.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

===Recapture, media portrayals, and legacy===
{{Quote|Mothma, a long-time political enemy of Emperor Palpatine, has never disguised her Rebel sympathies, and resigned her post as representative of Chandrila several years ago, ostensibly to enter a voluntary exile. Instead she disappeared.|An Imperial HoloVision report in 0 ABY that omitted Mothma's escape from Coruscant|<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets">{{JournalCite|4|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>}}
In 2 BBY,<ref name="Age of Rebellion" /> [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Mothma's escape,<ref name="NEGTC" /> she returned to Coruscant for a highly risky meeting at [[Cantham House/Legends|Cantham House]] with Organa and Bel Iblis, where they decided to formally create the Alliance.<ref name="Age of Rebellion" /> They next met on the planet Corellia<ref name="NEC" /> in a meeting facilitated by [[Galen Marek]], the secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Marek was working to unite the various rebel groups to overthrow the Emperor, in what was secretly a ploy by Vader and Palpatine to root out their enemies.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> The senators signed the [[Corellian Treaty]], unifying the [[Chandrilan resistance|Chandrilan]], [[Alderaanian Resistance|Alderaanian]], and Corellian resistance groups into the Rebel Alliance,<ref name="Rebel Dawn" /> but were captured by Vader and taken to Palpatine aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] for execution. However, they were [[Battle on Death Star I|rescued]] by Marek,<ref name="TFU" /> and the Alliance became embroiled in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the Empire.<ref name="NEC" /> Mothma was unanimously elected<ref name="Star Wars Sourcebook 2nd" /> the first [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the Alliance and continued travelling across the galaxy to further the Rebel cause.<ref name="Fact File 36" />

[[File:CoruscantGlobeE1.png|thumb|right|250px|Mon Mothma eventually returned to Coruscant (pictured) as the leader of the New Republic.]]
At one point, Mothma visited the [[Agamar Resistance|Resistance]] on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], where she gave a speech that mentioned her escape.<ref name="Farlander" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]] report referred to Mothma's public and memorable resignation several years earlier.<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets 3" /> Following the Rebel victory<ref name="NEC" /> at Yavin<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Galaxy NewsNets date">The [[Imperial HoloVision]] report in {{JournalCite|4|Galaxywide NewsNets}} states that it takes place on 35:9:1 of the [[Great ReSynchronization]] calendar, which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Mothma appeared on the [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore/Legends|Imperial Enforcement DataCore]], a list of the galaxy's most wanted criminals published by the [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]]. A report on the [[Imperial HoloVision]] stated that Mothma had previously resigned her Senate post and entered voluntary [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]],<ref name="Galaxywide NewsNets" /> rather than the truth of her escape from Coruscant.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> Following the death of Palpatine at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Mothma became [[Chief Councilor]] of the [[New Republic Ruling Council]] and eventually returned to Coruscant to govern from there<ref name="NEGTC" /> after it was [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

Mothma's escape was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Chronology]]'', a chronicle of galactic history compiled in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] by the New Republic [[Historical Council]],<ref name="Essential Chronology">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> and in its [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|updated version]] published in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|M-M-Mon Mothma! Senator Mon Mothma! She's wanted for treason by Emperor Palpatine, and I was supposed to help her get to the Outer Rim.|"Mouse" Temple, to Jax Keyne, in an unlicensed roleplaying game adventure|<ref name="Spark">{{ShadisCite|18.5|The Spark Before the Flame}}</ref>}}
[[File:Episodevi returnofthejedi.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The novelization of ''Return of the Jedi'' first introduced Mon Mothma's escape from the Empire.]]
The first reference to Mon Mothma going underground to resist the Empire was made in [[James Kahn]]'s [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> published on [[May 12]], [[1983]], prior to the film's premiere on May 25.<ref name="YBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Mothma's experience was later contextualised as an escape in ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published for use with [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[1990]]. The sourcebook did not explicitly state which planet Mothma escaped from.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> The ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and published in [[1992]], confirmed that Mothma fled from Coruscant.<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" />

Mothma's escape plays a significant role in "[[The Spark Before the Flame]]," an unlicensed roleplaying game adventure written by [[Sean Patrick Fannon]] and published in [[SHADIS Magazine 18.5|''SHADIS Magazine'' 18.5]] in [[April]] [[1995]]. The adventure is set shortly after Palpatine's transformation of the Republic into the Empire,<ref name="Spark" /> rather than the established timeline of Mothma's escape in approximately 2 BBY.<ref name="Date" /> In it, Mothma is stated to have received passage to a military space station with Organa's help after escaping<ref name="Spark" /> Coruscant.<ref name="Heir to the Empire sourcebook" /> From there, the plan was for her to board a [[Republic Scout Service/Legends|Scout Services]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that would take her to the main [[Supply Depot Port 27|spaceport]] on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet [[Renor]], from which she would take a transport to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] with the help of her contact, con artist [["Mouse" Temple]]. However, Mothma and her entourage are abducted by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] agents and taken to the dungeon of the [[Pel Talon's estate|castle]] of Senator [[Pel Talon]]. Meanwhile, Temple meets with Chandrilan [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jax Keyn]] to collect Mothma aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Blackjack (YT-1300 light freighter)|''Blackjack'']], but after Mothma fails to appear at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] they are attacked by Imperial agents. Keyn, his co-pilot [[Trillia (pilot)|Trillia]], Temple, and their new group of companions then set out to rescue Mothma.<ref name="Spark" />
